title: Former French President Nicolas Sarkozy has faced a litany of legal problems since his sole term in office between 2007 and 2012
text:
Former French President Nicolas Sarkozy has faced a litany of legal problems since his sole term in office between 2007 and 2012
- Hugo MATHY
- Updated
0
As featured on
A Paris court is to issue its verdict Thursday in the trial of former French president Nicolas Sarkozy on charges of accepting illegal campaign financing from late Libyan dictator Moamer Kadhafi, with prosecutors demanding a seven-year prison sentence.
